SELECT NVL(MAX(prescription_id), 0) FROM prescriptions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
INSERT INTO prescriptions ( user_id, dispensed_date, total_days, prescription_image_url, ai_summary_json, has_discontinued_drug, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{dispensedDate}, #{totalDays}, #{prescriptionImageUrl}, #{aiSummaryJson}, #{hasDiscontinuedDrug}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO prescription_items ( prescription_id, medication_id, daily_dose, daily_frequency, total_days, usage_timing ) VALUES ( #{prescriptionId}, #{medicationId}, #{dailyDose}, #{dailyFrequency}, #{totalDays}, #{usageTiming, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.prescription_id AS prescriptionId, p.user_id AS userId, p.dispensed_date AS dispensedDate, p.total_days AS totalDays, p.prescription_image_url AS prescriptionImageUrl, p.ai_summary_json AS aiSummaryJson, p.has_discontinued_drug AS hasDiscontinuedDrug, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM prescriptions p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM prescription_items pi WHERE pi.prescription_id = p.prescription_id ) ORDER BY p.prescription_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT pi.item_id AS itemId, pi.prescription_id AS prescriptionId, pi.medication_id AS medicationId, pi.daily_dose AS dailyDose, pi.daily_frequency AS dailyFrequency, pi.total_days AS totalDays, pi.usage_timing AS usageTiming, NVL(m.item_name, '처방약품') AS itemName, m.edi_code AS ediCode, m.class_name AS className, m.is_discontinued AS isDiscontinued FROM prescription_items pi LEFT JOIN medications m ON pi.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE pi.prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY pi.item_id ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT medication_id AS itemSeq, edi_code AS ediCode, item_name AS itemName, class_name AS className, is_discontinued AS isDiscontinued FROM medications WHERE edi_code = #{ediCode} OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(edi_code, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || #{ediCode} || ',') > 0 OR edi_code LIKE '%' || #{ediCode} || '%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN edi_code = #{ediCode} THEN 1 WHEN INSTR(',' || REPLACE(edi_code, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || #{ediCode} || ',') > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT medication_id AS itemSeq, edi_code AS ediCode, item_name AS itemName, class_name AS className, is_discontinued AS isDiscontinued FROM medications WHERE INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(item_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{keyword}, '[[:space:]]', ''))) > 0 OR item_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(item_name, '[[:space:]]', '')) = LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{keyword}, '[[:space:]]', '')) THEN 1 WHEN item_name LIKE #{keyword} || '%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
